class.name: GameplayGameState
class.brief_description: Shared, client-visible match state and player-state collection.
class.description: GameplayGameState contains the match phase and unique [GameplayPlayerState] instances. It is suitable for server-to-client state replication, while authoritative rules remain in [GameplayGameMode].

method.name: add_player_state
method.description: Adds a unique player state and establishes its reverse relationship.

method.name: get_player_states
method.description: Returns all live player states in insertion order.

method.name: has_player_state
method.description: Returns whether [param player_state] belongs to this match state.

method.name: remove_player_state
method.description: Removes [param player_state] and clears its reverse relationship.

members.member: An application-defined match phase such as [code]&"waiting"[/code] or [code]&"in_progress"[/code].
The number of live registered player states.

signal.name: player_state_added
signal.description: Emitted after a player state is registered.

signal.name: player_state_removed
signal.description: Emitted after a player state is removed.
